dataTypeDefinitions.name: Commercial Registry Number
dataTypeDefinitions.description: Party `details.commercial_registry_number`, for a party whose `details` is an organization.

dataTypeDefinitions.name: Tax Number
dataTypeDefinitions.description: Party `tax_number`, e.g. the German Steuernummer.

dataTypeDefinitions.name: Tax Id
dataTypeDefinitions.description: Party `tax_id`, e.g. the German USt-IdNr. or Steuer-ID.

dataTypeDefinitions.name: Trade Id
dataTypeDefinitions.description: Party `trade_id`, e.g. the German Betriebsnummer.

dataTypeDefinitions.name: Title
dataTypeDefinitions.description: Party `details.title`, for a party whose `details` is a person.

dataTypeDefinitions.name: First Name
dataTypeDefinitions.description: Party `details.first_name`, for a party whose `details` is a person.

dataTypeDefinitions.name: Last Name
dataTypeDefinitions.description: Party `details.last_name`, for a party whose `details` is a person.

dataTypeDefinitions.name: Memberships
dataTypeDefinitions.description: Party `details.memberships`, for a party whose `details` is a person, one nested AgmaSync-Membership per entry. Carries no value of its own: the value is the nested context items.

dataTypeDefinitions.name: Membership
dataTypeDefinitions.description: One entry of `details.memberships`. Carries no value of its own: the value is the nested context items.

dataTypeDefinitions.name: Member Organization Id
dataTypeDefinitions.description: Membership `organization_id`, as the Reference Id of a Party whose partyTypeCode is ORGANIZATION. A reference: the keyword names the target.

dataTypeDefinitions.name: Member Role
dataTypeDefinitions.description: Membership `member_role`, a code from the ADAPT Role enumeration.

dataTypeDefinitions.name: Specialised Usage Type
dataTypeDefinitions.description: Farm `specialised_usage_type`, drawn from AGROVOC where a matching concept exists.

dataTypeDefinitions.name: Partners
dataTypeDefinitions.description: Farm `partners`, one nested AgmaSync-Partner per entry. Carries no value of its own: the value is the nested context items.

dataTypeDefinitions.name: Partner
dataTypeDefinitions.description: One entry of farm `partners`. Carries no value of its own: the value is the nested context items.

dataTypeDefinitions.name: Partner Party Id
dataTypeDefinitions.description: Partner `partner_id`, as the Reference Id of a Party. A reference: the keyword names the target.

dataTypeDefinitions.name: Partner Role
dataTypeDefinitions.description: Partner `partner_role`, a code from the ADAPT Role enumeration.

dataTypeDefinitions.name: Geo Reference
dataTypeDefinitions.description: Farm `geo_reference`, as a WKT POINT in WGS84.

dataTypeDefinitions.name: Field Owner Party Id
dataTypeDefinitions.description: Field `owner`, as the Reference Id of a Party. Absent means the farm owner holds the field. A reference: the keyword names the target.

dataTypeDefinitions.name: Soil Type
dataTypeDefinitions.description: Soil `type`. Extensible enumeration, e.g. SAND, LOAMY_SAND, CLAY.

dataTypeDefinitions.name: Soil Rating Points
dataTypeDefinitions.description: Soil `rating_points` (Bodenzahl / Ackerzahl).

dataTypeDefinitions.name: Topography
dataTypeDefinitions.description: Field `topography`, the slope.

dataTypeDefinitions.name: Season Id
dataTypeDefinitions.description: Field `harvest_period`, as the Reference Id of a Season. ADAPT gives Field no Season Ids. A reference: the keyword names the target.

dataTypeDefinitions.name: Boundary Type
dataTypeDefinitions.description: Field boundary `boundary_type`. Extensible enumeration, e.g. OPERATIONAL, ADMINISTRATIVE_RECEIVED.

dataTypeDefinitions.name: Regulatory Requirement
dataTypeDefinitions.description: Field boundary `regulatory_requirements`. Extensible enumeration, e.g. RED_ZONE_NITROGEN.

dataTypeDefinitions.name: Obstacle Kind
dataTypeDefinitions.description: Obstacle `properties.kind`, e.g. pole, tree, waterhole.

dataTypeDefinitions.name: Metadata
dataTypeDefinitions.description: `metadata`, one nested AgmaSync-Metadata per key. Carries no value of its own: the value is the nested context items.

dataTypeDefinitions.name: Metadata Entry
dataTypeDefinitions.description: One key of `metadata`. Carries no value of its own: the value is the nested context items.

dataTypeDefinitions.name: Metadata Key
dataTypeDefinitions.description: The metadata key.

dataTypeDefinitions.name: Metadata Value
dataTypeDefinitions.description: The metadata value, JSON-encoded.
